desc: Ideation: reformulate as min `sum|s[i]-t[i]|` with all runs ≥ 3, design `g`/`h` suffix DP and greedy lex reconstruction
Implement the full solution (backward `h` DP + greedy forward reconstruction + `n < 3` → `""` edge case) in the starter-code format
Brute-force validator for small `n` (all good strings, min cost then lex-smallest) + random/tie-heavy cross-check harness, kept inert behind `RUN_BRUTE`
Re-verify the two correctness lemmas: `g[j][c] ≥ C[j][c] + h[j+1][c]` (justifying the global-min `m1` simplification) and one-successor-state-per-character (greedy lex validity)
Complexity/perf review: `O(26n)` time (~4 length-26 passes per index) and `O(26n)` memory, acceptable for `n = 5·10^4`
